steps.say: I was the Abbey's midwife. Forty years of mothers, and every one of them handed me their child and trusted me.
Then the Drip came into the cradles, and the Chandler said the ones who went to wax should be given to the flame. I couldn't. So I brought them down here instead, where it was quiet.
I sang to them so they wouldn't be frightened. I think I've been singing ever since.
Would you... no. No, you're grown. You don't need a lullaby.
She lies back into the pool as if into a bed. The wax closes over her face last. Around you, the pools go still.
